menu_name: The Kiwi Cafe - Queenstown Waterfront - Weekly Specials

items.name: Aged Ribeye Steak with Herb Butter
items.description: 28-day aged ribeye steak grilled to order, topped with a herb and garlic butter, served with roasted potatoes and a red wine jus.

items.name: Creamy Seafood Chowder
items.description: A rich chowder with salmon, prawns and clams in a cream and butter base, finished with fresh chives and served with toasted sourdough bread.

items.name: Wild Mushroom Risotto
items.description: Arborio rice slow-cooked with wild mushrooms, white wine, vegetable stock and finished with parmesan and butter.

items.name: Peanut Satay Chicken Skewers
items.description: Grilled chicken skewers served with a house-made peanut satay sauce, cucumber salad and jasmine rice.

items.name: Miso Glazed Salmon
items.description: Pan-seared salmon fillet glazed with a miso and soy reduction, served with steamed edamame and sesame greens.

items.name: Kumara and Almond Salad
items.description: Roasted kumara, rocket, toasted almonds and a citrus vinaigrette, topped with crumbled feta.

items.name: Classic Beef Burger
items.description: Beef pattie, cheddar cheese, egg mayonnaise, lettuce and tomato relish in a toasted brioche bun, served with fries.

items.name: Vegan Buddha Bowl
items.description: Quinoa, roasted vegetables, chickpeas, avocado and a tahini dressing. No animal products used.

items.name: Tempura Prawn Bowl
items.description: Lightly battered prawns and tempura vegetables with a soy dipping sauce, served over steamed rice.

items.name: Lemon Meringue Tart
items.description: Buttery shortcrust pastry filled with tangy lemon curd and topped with toasted egg white meringue.

items.name: Dried Apricot and Walnut Cake
items.description: Moist sponge cake with dried apricots and walnuts, layered with a mascarpone cream and dusted with icing sugar.

items.name: Truffle Mushroom Pasta
items.description: Fresh egg pasta tossed with sauteed mushrooms, truffle oil, cream and parmesan.

items.name: Grilled Snapper with Herb Salsa
items.description: Line-caught snapper fillet grilled and finished with a fresh herb and caper salsa, served with a garden salad.

items.name: Halloumi and Fig Salad
items.description: Grilled halloumi cheese with fresh figs, rocket, toasted hazelnuts and a balsamic glaze.

items.name: Smoked Salmon Eggs Benedict
items.description: Poached eggs and smoked salmon on a toasted English muffin, topped with a creamy hollandaise sauce.

items.name: Chocolate Hazelnut Brownie
items.description: Rich chocolate brownie with roasted hazelnuts, served warm with vanilla bean gelato and a chocolate sauce.
